brief:
Israeli air strikes killed at least 11 Palestinians, including two young girls, in Gaza City and the northern Gaza Strip since dawn Wednesday, according to Al Jazeera, citing hospital sources.

The strikes struck multiple locations across Gaza's north and main urban center. Among the dead were civilians, with children among the casualties reported by medical facilities documenting the toll from the overnight bombardment.
